payload.system_prompt: You are a travel-booking assistant helping a traveler manage existing flight reservations.
payload.user_request: Find Theodore Collins's existing flight reservation for Thursday, October 15, 2026 from New York to Los Angeles, verify that the reservation belongs to him by confirming the traveler details match Theodore Collins (born September 14, 1985) and the U.S. passport on file beginning with 'US876543', and then cancel that booking. Do not cancel anything unless the traveler verification succeeds.

tools.name: search_flights
tools.description: Search flight inventory and pricing by route, date, cabin, stop-count, or flight number.

date.description: Travel date in ISO format YYYY-MM-DD.

cabin_class.description: Cabin class such as economy, premium_economy, business, first.

nonstop_only.description: Optional boolean-like flag string indicating whether only nonstop flights should be returned.

flight_number.description: Optional flight number to look up directly.

reservation_id.description: Optional reservation identifier when searching direct replacement flights.

tools.name: search_airports
tools.description: Search and list airport records by city or accessibility.

origin_area.description: Origin city/region/airport for accessible international airport search.

international_only.description: Optional boolean-like flag string for international airports only.

tools.name: read_user_account
tools.description: Read account, traveler profile, payment instruments, and upcoming travel context.

name.description: Optional full name for account lookup.

zip_code.description: Optional ZIP or postal code for account lookup.

tools.name: read_reservations
tools.description: Read reservation and booking information including invoices, booked flight details, trip messages, meal selections, and reservation lookups.

reservation_id.description: Reservation or booking reference.

traveler_name.description: Optional traveler name for locating a reservation.

route.description: Optional route string such as JFK-LHR for locating a reservation.

date.description: Optional travel date for locating a reservation.

tools.name: read_saved_itineraries
tools.description: Read saved itineraries and airfare details by label or identifier.

tools.name: manage_booking
tools.description: Create, modify, rebook, insure, or cancel flight reservations.

action.description: One of book_flight, book_reservation, create_reservation, book_saved_itinerary, change_reservation, update_reservation_flights, rebook_reservation, purchase_insurance, cancel_booking, cancel_reservation.

reservation_id.description: Existing reservation identifier when modifying, insuring, rebooking, or canceling.

itinerary_id.description: Selected flight itinerary or saved itinerary identifier.

traveler_ids.description: Serialized list of traveler profile IDs.

add_ons.description: Serialized ancillaries such as baggage, meals, wifi, priority boarding.

replacement_flight_ids.description: Serialized list of replacement flight identifiers for change or rebook actions.

fare_class.description: Requested fare class when updating reservation flights.

insurance_plan_id.description: Insurance plan identifier when purchasing travel insurance.

tools.name: verify_travel_and_pricing
tools.description:
Verify totals, baggage, traveler identity, itinerary constraints, departures, notices, airport proximity, traveler profiles, and attached documents.

This tool is required before operations that depend on pricing or traveler data validation.
Commit tools such as manage_booking should only be called after this verification step when
pricing accuracy or traveler eligibility is a prerequisite.

check_type.description: One of calculate_total_flight_cost, verify_baggage_allowance, verify_earliest_departure_flights, verify_match_to_constraints, verify_traveler_information, verify_traveler_profile, verify_weather_reroute_notice, verify_nearest_airport_to_city, verify_itinerary_traveler_documents.

reservation_ids.description: Serialized list of reservation IDs for aggregate checks.

reservation_id.description: Reservation identifier for booking-specific checks.

flight_ids.description: Serialized list of flight IDs for departure or constraint checks.

constraints.description: Serialized user constraints such as nonstop_only, max_stops, latest_arrival, budget.

provided_details.description: Serialized identifying or passport details to compare.

candidate_airport_codes.description: Serialized list of airport codes to compare.

route.description: Route or flight context for weather reroute verification.

tools.name: travel_documents_and_customs
tools.description: Search customs rules and read visa application status; covers compensation policy lookups.

country.description: Destination country relevant to customs or visa.

flight_id.description: Flight identifier for compensation policy context.

reservation_id.description: Reservation identifier for compensation policy context.

tools.name: manage_trip_preparation
tools.description: Read and update travel-preparation items including medications, customs declaration flags, archived refills, packing lists, and readiness checklist.

action.description: One of read_medication_refill_list, archive_medication_from_active_refills, flag_medication_for_customs_declaration, remove_medication_from_trip_pack_list, update_travel_checklist.

medication_id.description: Medication identifier when acting on a medication.

trip_id.description: Trip or reservation context for packing/checklist updates.

checklist_updates.description: Serialized checklist item changes and readiness status.

tools.name: verify_medication_rules
tools.description:
Cross-check medication records against customs rules for the destination country.

This tool is required before operations that depend on medication customs compliance.
Commit tools such as manage_trip_preparation (flag_medication_for_customs_declaration) should
only be called after this verification step to determine which medications require declaration.

medication_ids.description: Serialized list of medication identifiers to evaluate.

tools.name: manage_budget_and_currency
tools.description: Set trip budget limits and compute exchange rates.

action.description: One of set_budget_limit, set_travel_budget_limit, set_trip_budget_limit, compute_exchange_rate.

trip_id.description: Trip or reservation identifier for trip-specific budget changes.

currency.description: Budget currency or target currency for exchange-rate computation.

access_token.description: Access token when required for budget operations.

tools.name: manage_calendar_and_absence
tools.description: Read, reschedule, cancel calendar events, and manage work absence records.

action.description: One of read_personal_calendar_event, reschedule_calendar_event, cancel_calendar_event, set_work_absence_code, verify_work_absence_status.

new_start_time.description: New event start time in ISO format.

new_end_time.description: New event end time in ISO format.

details.description: Updated event details or absence metadata.

tools.name: compensation_and_support
tools.description: Create support tickets and submit compensation requests for disrupted bookings.

action.description: One of create_support_ticket or submit_compensation_request.

reservation_id.description: Reservation tied to the issue or compensation request.

tools.name: orders_and_returns
tools.description: Read retail order and product information and submit returns for delivered items.

action.description: One of get_order_details, read_order_delivery_status, get_product_details, list_all_product_types, return_delivered_order_items.

item_ids.description: Serialized list of delivered order item identifiers to return.

refund_payment_instrument_id.description: Payment instrument to receive the refund.

action.description: One of book_flight, book_reservation, create_reservation, book_saved_itinerary, change_reservation, update_reservation_flights, rebook_reservation, purchase_insurance, cancel_booking, cancel_reservation.

reservation_id.description: Existing reservation identifier when modifying, insuring, rebooking, or canceling.

itinerary_id.description: Selected flight itinerary or saved itinerary identifier.

traveler_ids.description: Serialized list of traveler profile IDs.

add_ons.description: Serialized ancillaries such as baggage, meals, wifi, priority boarding.

replacement_flight_ids.description: Serialized list of replacement flight identifiers for change or rebook actions.

fare_class.description: Requested fare class when updating reservation flights.

insurance_plan_id.description: Insurance plan identifier when purchasing travel insurance.

tools.name: verify_travel_and_pricing
tools.description:
Verify totals, baggage, traveler identity, itinerary constraints, departures, notices, airport proximity, traveler profiles, and attached documents.

This tool is required before operations that depend on pricing or traveler data validation.
Commit tools such as manage_booking should only be called after this verification step when
pricing accuracy or traveler eligibility is a prerequisite.

check_type.description: One of calculate_total_flight_cost, verify_baggage_allowance, verify_earliest_departure_flights, verify_match_to_constraints, verify_traveler_information, verify_traveler_profile, verify_weather_reroute_notice, verify_nearest_airport_to_city, verify_itinerary_traveler_documents.

reservation_ids.description: Serialized list of reservation IDs for aggregate checks.

reservation_id.description: Reservation identifier for booking-specific checks.

flight_ids.description: Serialized list of flight IDs for departure or constraint checks.

constraints.description: Serialized user constraints such as nonstop_only, max_stops, latest_arrival, budget.

provided_details.description: Serialized identifying or passport details to compare.

candidate_airport_codes.description: Serialized list of airport codes to compare.

route.description: Route or flight context for weather reroute verification.

tools.name: travel_documents_and_customs
tools.description: Search customs rules and read visa application status; covers compensation policy lookups.

country.description: Destination country relevant to customs or visa.

flight_id.description: Flight identifier for compensation policy context.

reservation_id.description: Reservation identifier for compensation policy context.

tools.name: manage_trip_preparation
tools.description: Read and update travel-preparation items including medications, customs declaration flags, archived refills, packing lists, and readiness checklist.

action.description: One of read_medication_refill_list, archive_medication_from_active_refills, flag_medication_for_customs_declaration, remove_medication_from_trip_pack_list, update_travel_checklist.

medication_id.description: Medication identifier when acting on a medication.

trip_id.description: Trip or reservation context for packing/checklist updates.

checklist_updates.description: Serialized checklist item changes and readiness status.

tools.name: verify_medication_rules
tools.description:
Cross-check medication records against customs rules for the destination country.

This tool is required before operations that depend on medication customs compliance.
Commit tools such as manage_trip_preparation (flag_medication_for_customs_declaration) should
only be called after this verification step to determine which medications require declaration.

medication_ids.description: Serialized list of medication identifiers to evaluate.

tools.name: manage_budget_and_currency
tools.description: Set trip budget limits and compute exchange rates.

action.description: One of set_budget_limit, set_travel_budget_limit, set_trip_budget_limit, compute_exchange_rate.

trip_id.description: Trip or reservation identifier for trip-specific budget changes.

currency.description: Budget currency or target currency for exchange-rate computation.

access_token.description: Access token when required for budget operations.

tools.name: manage_calendar_and_absence
tools.description: Read, reschedule, cancel calendar events, and manage work absence records.

action.description: One of read_personal_calendar_event, reschedule_calendar_event, cancel_calendar_event, set_work_absence_code, verify_work_absence_status.

new_start_time.description: New event start time in ISO format.

new_end_time.description: New event end time in ISO format.

details.description: Updated event details or absence metadata.

tools.name: compensation_and_support
tools.description: Create support tickets and submit compensation requests for disrupted bookings.

action.description: One of create_support_ticket or submit_compensation_request.

reservation_id.description: Reservation tied to the issue or compensation request.

tools.name: orders_and_returns
tools.description: Read retail order and product information and submit returns for delivered items.

action.description: One of get_order_details, read_order_delivery_status, get_product_details, list_all_product_types, return_delivered_order_items.

item_ids.description: Serialized list of delivered order item identifiers to return.

refund_payment_instrument_id.description: Payment instrument to receive the refund.

payload.system_prompt: You are a travel-booking assistant helping a traveler manage existing flight reservations.
payload.user_request: Find Theodore Collins's existing flight reservation for Thursday, October 15, 2026 from New York to Los Angeles, verify that the reservation belongs to him by confirming the traveler details match Theodore Collins (born September 14, 1985) and the U.S. passport on file beginning with 'US876543', and then cancel that booking. Do not cancel anything unless the traveler verification succeeds.

tools.name: search_flights
tools.description: Search flight inventory and pricing by route, date, cabin, stop-count, or flight number.

date.description: Travel date in ISO format YYYY-MM-DD.

cabin_class.description: Cabin class such as economy, premium_economy, business, first.

nonstop_only.description: Optional boolean-like flag string indicating whether only nonstop flights should be returned.

flight_number.description: Optional flight number to look up directly.

reservation_id.description: Optional reservation identifier when searching direct replacement flights.

tools.name: search_airports
tools.description: Search and list airport records by city or accessibility.

origin_area.description: Origin city/region/airport for accessible international airport search.

international_only.description: Optional boolean-like flag string for international airports only.

tools.name: read_user_account
tools.description: Read account, traveler profile, payment instruments, and upcoming travel context.

name.description: Optional full name for account lookup.

zip_code.description: Optional ZIP or postal code for account lookup.

tools.name: read_reservations
tools.description: Read reservation and booking information including invoices, booked flight details, trip messages, meal selections, and reservation lookups.

reservation_id.description: Reservation or booking reference.

traveler_name.description: Optional traveler name for locating a reservation.

route.description: Optional route string such as JFK-LHR for locating a reservation.

date.description: Optional travel date for locating a reservation.
